coverage.schema: rows match calendar_tables.json rows (family, date, local_time, timezone, source_url, vintage) plus an optional note; every row is America/New_York
coverage.bls_families: consumer_price_index, producer_price_index, employment_situation, job_openings_and_labor_turnover: 20 each. Dates read from the BLS yearly schedules https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2019/home.htm and https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2020/home.htm (raw pages fetched in a browser because bls.gov returns 403 to scripts) and from the BLS release archives https://www.bls.gov/bls/news-release/cpi.htm, /ppi.htm, /empsit.htm, /jolts.htm (file names carry the release date); all 80 agree. source_url is the archived release document (HTTP 200 checked). 08:30 ET for CPI, PPI, Employment Situation; 10:00 ET for JOLTS, as printed on the schedules.
coverage.bea_families: gross_domestic_product, personal_income_and_outlays: 20 each. Dates from the BEA news release schedules https://apps.bea.gov/scb/issues/2018/12-december/1218-news-releases-2019.htm and https://apps.bea.gov/scb/issues/2019/12-december/1219-news-releases-2020.htm and from the BEA release archive https://www.bea.gov/news/archive; all agree. Date and time regenerated from the 'EMBARGOED UNTIL RELEASE AT' line of each release page (source_url): 08:30 ET except three Personal Income and Outlays releases at 10:00 ET (2019-11-27, 2019-12-20, 2020-11-25). GDP vintage is advance, second or third; 2019-05-30 is the Q1 2019 second estimate (the Q1 advance of 2019-04-26 is before the window).
coverage.retail_sales: 20. Date and time regenerated from the first page of each Census Advance Monthly Retail Trade report (https://www2.census.gov/retail/releases/historical/marts/adv<YYMM>.pdf, 'FOR RELEASE AT 8:30 AM'), cross-checked against the Census economic-indicator calendar (archived 2019-08-12 for 2019; https://www.census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview-2020.html for 2020).
coverage.durable_goods: 20. Advance Report on Durable Goods dates as printed in the Census M3 full report of the previous data month ('The Advance Report on durable goods for <month> is scheduled for release on <date> at 8:30 a.m.'), i.e. the publisher's scheduled date; identical to the Census economic-indicator calendar (web.archive.org/web/20190812025609/https://www.census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html for 2019, https://www.census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview-2020.html for 2020). No archived copy of the advance reports themselves was found, so these are published schedule dates, not observed release timestamps.
coverage.michigan_consumer_sentiment: 40 (20 survey months x preliminary and final). Dates regenerated from the University of Michigan 'Release Dates 1991 through 2027' table (the document the existing calendar cites). The table prints no clock time; 10:00 ET follows the existing calendar and is corroborated by FXStreet previews for 2019-09-13 (https://www.fxstreet.com/analysis/us-michigan-consumer-sentiment-preview-whos-got-trouble-201909122341) and 2020-03-13 (https://www.fxstreet.com/analysis/us-michigan-consumer-sentiment-march-preview-where-will-consumers-lead-202003121746); no first-party statement of the 2019-2020 clock time was found.
coverage.ism_families: ism_manufacturing_pmi, ism_services_pmi: 20 each. ismworld.org calendar pages sit behind a login wall for scripts and its 2019 calendar is not archived, so each row cites ISM's own press release on PR Newswire (https://www.prnewswire.com/news/institute-for-supply-management/), whose page header carries the release timestamp (all 40 read 10:00 ET on the row's date). The 2020 dates also agree with ISM's release-calendar table archived at web.archive.org/web/20200809022121/https://www.ismworld.org/supply-management-news-and-reports/reports/rob-report-calendar/. The rule 'first business day / third business day' held for 38 of the 40 releases; it fails for 2020-01-03 (rule gives 2020-01-02) and 2020-01-07 (rule gives 2020-01-06), so quant.calendar_events.rule_events emits two wrong rule rows in January 2020 that a fetched row does not override (different dates).
coverage.fomc: Times read from each statement page ('For release at'); decisions and range changes checked against the statement text (change_basis_points = change in the upper bound of the target range). scheduled=true: the 13 regular meetings. scheduled=false: the emergency rate actions 2020-03-03 10:00 EST (-50 bp) and 2020-03-15 17:00 EDT (Sunday, -100 bp), plus three off-cycle FOMC statements that changed no rate (2019-10-11 11:00 EDT implementation statement, 2020-03-23 08:00 EDT notation-vote statement, 2020-08-27 09:10 EDT strategy statement); drop those three if only rate decisions are wanted (kind is not rate_decision). The regular meeting of 2020-03-17/18 was cancelled: no statement exists on 2020-03-18. Fed press releases of 2020-03-19 and 2020-03-31 (swap lines, FIMA repo) are not FOMC statements and are not included.
